caption: The drawing features a rectangular tray with rounded corners, depicted on a plain off-white background. The tray has a black surface with a gold decorative border, which includes stylized floral and vine patterns along the edge. In the center of the tray, there is an arrangement of brightly colored flowers and leaves, including white, red, and yellow blossoms with green and yellow-green foliage. Behind the floral arrangement, there is a depiction of a small, tiered brown and orange fountain, with white streams of water arching outward and upward. Smaller white flowers with yellow centers and green stems are distributed on both sides of the main floral cluster. The overall composition centers the floral and fountain motif within the bordered tray, surrounded by gold ornamental detailing. A ruled scale is visible in the bottom left margin, and handwritten notations are present below the tray image.
title: Tray
